verdict.rationale: Snowflake ships an official, first-party Snowflake CLI, confirmed by a probe. Its docs say developers can use it to create, manage, update, and view apps across Streamlit in Snowflake, Native Apps, Snowpark Container Services, and Snowpark. The evidence is a single repeated summary sentence with no depth on commands or agent-oriented usage. Missing for 10: detail on command coverage beyond app workloads (e.g., SQL execution, object management), evidence of AI/agent-friendly features (machine-readable output, non-interactive auth), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
